findings: Round-1 blocker fixed: lz-tethers is no longer drawn in the lens copy in any preset × ratio (tether.mjs: 0 rim samples in all 12, was 51–53); context keeps its tethers page→zone

No supplied field or discrete object cut by the rim: zone-place, zone copies, cap, dock/was wholly inside at every lens frame; only continuous backdrop planes (walls, floor, board body) run past the rim as an ordinary crop — page-place, door and door-leaf lie wholly outside the clip and are not visible

Lens reads as one copy of the datum with its zone (zone card + ◆ caption; context caption reduced to a blank ◆ placeholder); after-value and was/antes old value both whole and legible at u 0.7 in every combination
Lens metrics incl. sized hosts (4 viewports, w/3×h/3): text magnification min 2.05 (16:9), 2.05 (1:1), 2.15 (9:16); smaller side min 0.373 (1:1); visible context min 0.482 (1:1) — no regression
